LETTER OF PROTEST (WEATHER)

Date: [DATE]
Port: [PORT_NAME]
Vessel: [VESSEL_NAME]

To: The Shippers / Charterers / Receivers

Dear Sirs,

Please be informed that the [CARGO_OP] operation of the above-mentioned vessel was interrupted due to adverse weather conditions as follows:

Nature of Weather: [WEATHER_DESC]

Stoppage Time: [STOP_TIME]
Resumption Time: [RESUME_TIME]

Please note that the Master and Owners hold you responsible for all delays, time lost, and consequences arising from this interruption. This letter is issued without prejudice to the rights and defenses of the Owners under the Charter Party and/or Bill of Lading.

Yours faithfully,

Master of MV [VESSEL_NAME]

content:
LETTER OF PROTEST (SLOW OPERATIONS)

Date: [CURRENT_DATE]
Port: [PORT_NAME]
Vessel: [VESSEL_NAME]

To: The Charterers / Agents

Dear Sirs,

I hereby protest against the slow working rate during the cargo operations. The vessel has experienced unnecessary delays due to:

Reason: [REASON]
Estimated Time Lost: [DELAY_HOURS] hours

Please be advised that the vessel considers this time as counting as Laytime (or Demurrage if applicable). We hold you responsible for all time lost.

Yours faithfully,

Master of MV [VESSEL_NAME]
